evidence: Three foundation-model backends with the stated versions exist: TimesFM-2.0-500m (predictors/timesfm_hf.py:1,30, checkpoint models/timesfm/), Chronos-2 via chronos-forecasting>=2.0 (predictors/chronos2.py:1,3-4,34, models/chronos/), Toto-2.0-2.5B (predictors/toto.py:1,27,34, models/toto/). Three classical baselines exist: naive (predictors/naive.py), ewma = exponential smoothing / EWMA (predictors/ewma.py), holt_winters (predictors/holt_winters.py). All six registered together in benchmark.py:88-95 MODELS. Rolling-origin protocol: forecast origins on a common multiples-of-H grid, stride H tiles the timeline contiguously (predictors/benchmark.py:5-12,113-118 grid_origins). Model dirs models/{timesfm,chronos,toto} present.
